title: Static deployment and optional services
description: Deploy static output on Cloudflare, Vercel, Netlify, EdgeOne, ESA or your own VPS, and register optional external services through consent.

cells.title: Publish the same static site on hosted platforms or your own VPS.
cells.text: Build with npm run build. Every platform serves dist/. Page rendering, search and local JavaScript work without a website backend.

cells.heading: Platform configuration
paragraphs: Cloudflare reads wrangler.jsonc and serves static assets without a Worker script. Vercel reads vercel.json; Netlify reads netlify.toml; Tencent EdgeOne Pages reads edgeone.json; Alibaba Cloud ESA Pages reads esa.jsonc. For a VPS, configure deploy.vps in a private config.yml.

Use each hosted platform's own authentication; use SSH/SFTP with direct password or private-key authentication on a VPS. GitHub Actions runs dependency security and compatibility checks, not production deployment.

cells.title: Choose a deployment platform
cells.code:
npm run deploy:cloudflare
npm run deploy:vercel
npm run deploy:netlify
npm run deploy:edgeone -- -n my-site
npm run deploy:esa -- --name my-site
edgepress d --dry-run
edgepress d

cells.heading: Deploy to a VPS with edgepress d
paragraphs: In a private config.yml, set deploy.vps.host, username, remotePath and password, or choose passwordEnv or privateKey instead. port defaults to 22. Never publish real credentials to GitHub.

hostKeySha256 is optional. When set, it verifies the SSH server key fingerprint; without it, EdgePress warns and connects without server identity verification. Run edgepress d --dry-run to validate local output first. The SSH user needs SFTP and permission to write and rename directories in the parent of remotePath.

EdgePress stages dist/ and swaps directories after upload. It removes old content and attempts to restore the original directory if the final swap fails. The VPS needs a static web server, not Node.js. Agent instructions are at the root in agent.md.

cells.heading: Optional APIs and widgets
paragraphs: Register external services in config.yml under plugins.consent.services. Use external-api with backendUrl for visitor-triggered API calls, or external-widget with backendUrl and a same-service moduleUrl exporting mount for an isolated interface.

Each service needs a unique ID, name, purpose, dataCategories, recipient, retention and HTTPS privacyUrl. Localized disclosure maps must cover every enabled site language. Do not put operator secrets in browser configuration.

Enable the group only after setting real service URLs and the privacy controller. The browser imports no service module and makes no API call before explicit per-service consent. Endpoint changes invalidate previous consent.

cells.title: Call a registered API from a theme asset

cells.heading: Comment service ownership
cells.text: iask owns its entire interface, translations, styles, authentication, uploads, storage and API. The website supplies only a generic service slot and published content context. Its deployment and credentials are managed separately.

cells.heading: Cache policy
paragraphs: CSS and JavaScript names include a content hash, including local module dependencies. Cloudflare, Vercel and EdgeOne cache these immutable URLs for one year. HTML and unversioned metadata revalidate so a rebuild can publish new references immediately.

ESA serves the same hashed assets. Configure its browser and edge cache rules for CSS and JS to one year, while leaving HTML and unversioned JSON short-lived. esa.jsonc configures the build and asset directory; it has no documented equivalent of Vercel custom headers.
